prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: PROJET_CASSANDRE painted retro FPS enemy animation atlas, genuine transparent RGBA background.
Input image 1 is ONLY the approved hero's painted art style reference. Input image 2 is the previous Costard atlas, ONLY for enemy costume, sunglasses, pistol and pose vocabulary. Create entirely new illustrated enemy sprites, NOT a render of a 3D model.
Subject in every frame: the same stern middle-aged security henchman in a dark navy charcoal business suit, white dress shirt, vivid burgundy red necktie, polished dark shoes, short combed grey hair, black rectangular sunglasses, medium warm beige skin, clean shaven square jaw. A small dark steel pistol in his RIGHT hand. Body moderately broad, imposing and believable like the hero, not skinny primitive shapes. Costume never changes. Strong readable silhouette, fabric folds, lapels, hands, face, contrast and controlled shaded pixel-painted style matching image 1. NO hero hoodie or beard.
CRITICAL layout: a tall rectangular sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT evenly spaced columns and TWELVE evenly spaced rows = 96 separate full sprites. Every row contains all 8 directions of the same action. Uniform invisible grid. Each slot has ample transparent padding on ALL sides: nothing touches neighboring slots or sheet edge, no clipping of arms, muzzle flash or prone bodies. Full entire person visible. Center body in each column, feet on the same baseline within each row. All upright figures same height. Prone figures naturally LOW and wide, not enlarged. Width of cell sufficient for a fallen body, keep all sprites small enough to fit. NO grid lines, titles, labels, numbers, shadows on ground, background, text or watermark.
DIRECTIONS columns left to right IN EVERY ROW: 1 front, 2 front three-quarter facing RIGHT on image, 3 RIGHT profile, 4 rear three-quarter facing RIGHT, 5 directly back, 6 rear three-quarter facing LEFT, 7 LEFT profile, 8 front three-quarter facing LEFT.
TWELVE ROWS top to bottom, exact:
0 IDLE: upright relaxed alert posture, pistol pointing down beside right thigh.
1 ALERT: spotting player, tense shoulders, pistol brought to chest ready to raise.
2 WALK LEFT STRIDE: pursuing with left leg forward, right leg back, pistol low ready.
3 WALK PASSING: pursuing, legs passing each other, knees bent slightly, pistol low ready.
4 WALK RIGHT STRIDE: pursuing with right leg forward, left leg back, pistol low ready.
5 AIM / TELEGRAPH: planted feet, both hands grip pistol extended aiming straight ahead of his OWN facing direction; unmistakably distinct from idle.
6 FIRE: same planted aiming posture but small bright yellow orange muzzle burst at barrel, subtle recoil, no giant flame.
7 HURT: torso rocks backwards reacting to bullet impact, bent elbows, gun hand drawn back, still standing.
8 DEATH FIRST: clutching abdomen with left hand, gun lowering, knees buckling, bent forward, clearly wounded.
9 DEATH KNEEL: down on both knees beginning to topple, shoulders droop.
10 DEATH FALL: collapsed sideways close to ground, body partly curled and arm loosened.
11 CORPSE: motionless lying fully on his side on floor, entire body horizontally laid out, pistol beside right hand, subtle blood spot underneath only.
This is a real game animation asset: consistent face proportions, outfit colors, pistol, proportions and view directions across 96 frames. Actual transparent alpha everywhere outside sprites. Low resolution hand-painted late-1990s shooter illustration, not anime, not smooth 3D, not photorealistic. Prioritize exact grid count and isolated silhouettes.
referenceImages: public/assets/sprites/costard.png (version 3069d51, rendue depuis le modèle CC0)
